disposition: Retained byte-for-byte for audit. Not used for any manuscript number. Round-1 published evidence is untouched.
observed_before_quarantine: Aggregate round-2 counts were computed and inspected before the defect was found; the re-execution is therefore declared as a second exploratory attempt, not a fresh confirmatory run.
root_cause: RunLedger idempotency/terminal_after_success guard is per-process in-memory; two concurrent census processes shared one ledger file and neither observed the other's CALL_STARTED.
why_invalid: Protocol requires retry=0, no replacement: 68 tasks received a second paid attempt.
Recorded task outcome is whichever concurrent writer won the race, not a single prescribed attempt.
Double sampling inflates apparent pass rate; 4 tasks demonstrably disagreed between their two calls.
